name: ListSyntheticDetail

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Currently, only cn-hangzhou is supported
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the monitoring task. This parameter is required. Valid values:

1: instant test
2: scheduled test
parameters.help_zh: 拨测类型，必填，即时拨测：1，定时拨测：2
parameters.name: synthetic_type

parameters.help_en: The result category. This parameter is required. Set the value to SYNTHETIC
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The type of the test result to retrieve. This parameter is required. Specify different values to retrieve different types of test results:

PING list: ICMP_LIST
TCP list: TCP_LIST
DNS list: DNS_LIST
HTTP(S) list: HTTP_LIST
Website speed test list: WEBSITE_LIST
File download list: DOWNLOAD_LIST
Test result details: ALL
parameters.help_zh:
拨测结果内容，必填，获取不同类型的拨测结果传不同的值：

PING列表：ICMP_LIST
TCP列表：TCP_LIST
DNS列表：DNS_LIST
HTTP(s)列表：HTTP_LIST
网站测速列表：WEBSITE_LIST
文件下载列表：DOWNLOAD_LIST
拨测结果明细：ALL
parameters.name: detail
filters

fields.help_en:
The filter field. The taskType and dataId fields are supported.

To query the list of test results: taskType
To query the details of test results: dataId
fields.help_zh:
筛选条件，支持taskType和dataId字段。

查询拨测结果列表：taskType
查询拨测结果详情：dataId
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The filter type. Valid values: eq (equal to) and in (contains)
fields.help_zh: 筛选类型，支持eq（等于）和in（包含）
fields.name: op_type

fields.help_en:
The value of the filter condition.
Task types:
1: ICMP.
2: TCP.
3: DNS.
4: HTTP.
5: Website speed test.
6: File download
fields.help_zh:
筛选条件的value。
任务类型：
1：ICMP；
2：TCP；
3：DNS；
4：HTTP；
5：网站测速；
6：文件下载
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The array of advanced filter conditions. This parameter is required.

To query the list of test results: [{"Key":"taskType","OpType":"in","Value":[task type]}].
To query the details of test results: [{"Key":"dataId","OpType":"eq","Value":"dataId"}]. The dataId is the dataId field returned in the test result list query
parameters.help_zh:
筛选条件数组，必填。

查询拨测结果列表：[{"Key":"taskType","OpType":"in","Value":[任务类型]}]。
查询拨测结果详情：[{"Key":"dataId","OpType":"eq","Value":"dataId"}] ，dataId为查任务拨测结果列表返回值的dataId字段
parameters.name: advanced_filters

parameters.help_en: The timestamp of the query start time. This parameter is required. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询起始时间的时间戳，必填，精确到毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The timestamp of the query end time. This parameter is required. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间的时间戳，必填，精确到毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The field used for sorting. Only timestamp (the time when the test is initiated) is supported
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，仅支持：timestamp（拨测发起时间）
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

`ASC`: Ascending order.
`DESC`: Descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序标准。取值：

`ASC`：升序。
`DESC`：降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates success
